push.title: Browser notifications
push.description: Get a notification from your browser for the events that reach your bell, even when the CRM is closed. You choose which events in the Push column below.
push.unsupported: This browser cannot show notifications while the CRM is closed. Try an up-to-date Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari, on a secure (https) page.
push.needsInstall: On iPhone and iPad, browser notifications only work for an app added to your Home Screen.
push.needsInstallSteps: Open this page in Safari, tap Share, choose Add to Home Screen, then open the CRM from the new icon and come back here. Needs iOS or iPadOS 16.4 or later.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser.
push.blockedHelp: Only your browser can undo this: open the site settings (the icon next to the address), set Notifications to Allow, then come back to this page.
push.offHelp: Not enabled on this device. Your browser will ask for permission when you press Enable.
push.onHelp: This device gets a browser notification for the events you switched on below, when you are not looking at the CRM.
push.howItWorks: You are not notified while the CRM is open and in front of you (the bell and pop-ups cover that). The notification shows who and what kind of event, never the message text.

testResult.sent: Sent. It should appear on your devices in a moment, even if the CRM is closed.
testResult.none_reachable: Your browser or its push service could not be reached just now. Try again in a moment; a device that is gone is removed automatically.
testResult.no_device: There is no device to send to. Enable notifications on this device first.
testResult.wait: A test was just sent. Wait a few seconds before sending another.

problem.enable_failed: Could not enable notifications on this device. Try again.
problem.disable_failed: Could not turn off notifications on this device. Try again.
problem.remove_failed: Could not remove that device. Try again.
problem.test_failed: Could not send the test. Try again.

testInApp.watch: You should see a pop-up, the bell number and the tab title change.
testInApp.notConnected: Live updates are not connected on this page, so the pop-up cannot appear here. Reload the page and try again.
testInApp.off: No bell notification was created: the bell is turned off for "Test notification" in the table below, or by your workspace owner.
